passages.text: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”
passages.sermon:
John was a Christian prophet and apostle.
John saw a vision.
John looked.
He saw a door.
The door stood open in heaven.
John heard a voice.
He had heard this voice before.
The voice sounded like a trumpet.
The voice spoke to John.
The voice said, “Come up here.”
The voice said, “I will show you what must happen after these things.”
passages.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετ’ ἐμοῦ λέγων Ἀνάβα ὧδε καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα

passages.text: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.
passages.sermon:
John is the one speaking.
John is a follower of Jesus.
John received a vision from God.
Immediately, the Holy Spirit took hold of John.
John saw a throne.
The throne stood in heaven.
Someone sat on the throne.
passages.original: εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν Πνεύματι καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος

passages.text: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
passages.sermon:
I saw someone sitting on the throne in heaven.
This person looked like jasper.
This person also looked like carnelian.
A rainbow surrounded the throne.
The rainbow shone like an emerald.
passages.original: καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ

passages.text: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.
passages.sermon:
Twenty-four thrones stood around the main throne in heaven.
Twenty-four elders sat on these thrones.
Each elder wore white clothing.
Each elder had a golden crown on his head.
passages.original: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρες καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς

passages.text: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.
passages.sermon:
God sat on the throne.
Flashes of lightning came from the throne.
Rumblings came from the throne.
Peals of thunder came from the throne.
Seven torches of fire burned in front of the throne.
These seven torches are the seven Spirits of God.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ἅ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
passages.sermon:
God sits on His throne in heaven.
In front of the throne, there is something like a sea of glass.
This sea looks clear, like crystal.
In the center, around the throne, are four living creatures.
Each living creature is covered with eyes in front and in back.
passages.original: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσαρα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν

passages.text: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
passages.sermon:
John saw four living creatures near the throne of God.
The first living creature looked like a lion.
The second living creature looked like a calf.
The third living creature had a face like a man.
The fourth living creature looked like an eagle flying.
passages.original: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ἔχων τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς ἀνθρώπου καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ

passages.text: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
passages.sermon:
There are four living creatures.
Each living creature stands around the throne of God.
Each living creature has six wings.
Eyes cover each living creature all around and within.
These living creatures do not rest during the day or night.
They always say, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty.”
The Lord God Almighty was, is, and is to come.
passages.original: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ἓν καθ’ ἓν αὐτῶν ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες Ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος

passages.text: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever, the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.”
passages.sermon:
There is a throne in heaven.
God sits on this throne.
God lives forever and ever.
There are four living creatures near the throne.
These living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to God.
Whenever the living creatures do this, something happens.
Twenty-four elders are also near the throne.
The twenty-four elders fall down before God.
They worship God, who lives forever and ever.
The elders take off their crowns.
They cast their crowns before the throne.
The elders say, “You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory, honor, and power.
You created all things.
By your will, all things exist and were created.”
passages.original: Καὶ ὅταν δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου λέγοντες Ἄξιος εἶ ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας τὰ πάντα καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν
